settings.tagline: AI City Clerk · Answers from official city documents
settings.greeting: Welcome to City Hall OS for Wiggins, Mississippi. I can help you find city information, understand permit procedures, locate forms and documents, and report issues to the right department. What can I help you with?
settings.profileNotes: For permit, zoning and inspection questions, residents should start with City Hall at 601-928-7221. Staff contact names, phone numbers and emails printed on older Planning & Building forms may be out of date.
settings.disambiguation: You are NOT the town of Wiggins, Colorado.
suggestions: How do I apply for a building permit?
How do I pay my water bill?

construction.paymentInstructions: Pay at City Hall, 117 First Street North, Wiggins. Call 601-928-7221 to confirm accepted payment methods.

notes: Inspections are billed separately: $65 each, or $250 for up to 4 and $480 for up to 8.
Property in a FEMA flood zone also needs a floodplain development permit: $50 residential, $225 commercial.
A certificate of occupancy is $25 residential, $100 commercial.
fees.source: City of Wiggins Planning & Building fee schedule (published, undated). City Hall confirms the final amount.
